description: OpenClaw's gateway running on Linux, found as a running process and not only as an install.
why: The proc kind's scenario. A row of kind proc whose id is openclaw can come only from osquery/queries/running.sql reading a node process whose script sits under node_modules/openclaw, and it is what marks the finding running. The npm row says the same agent is installed, so the pair is installed-and-running. The gateway renames its processes, which is why the query reads the runtime off the executable path rather than the process name.
known_gaps: The gateway runs with a throwaway token and no channel or model. This proves what a running gateway looks like to osquery, not an agent at work.
